verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Offline support' help article. That article states snoozed messages reappear only once 'you're back online', which implies an offline mode that catches up after reconnecting. The pack does not document which actions work offline (reading, searching, composing) or how queued changes sync back, so only partial credit is earned. JMAP's efficient sync is a protocol property and is not credited as offline-client support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offline reading, offline search and offline composing/sending, details of change syncing on reconnect, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
